resources.string: Liquid Volume uses the AccessibilityService API exclusively to detect physical volume up/down key presses and display your custom liquid glass volume slider instead of the system volume dialog. It never monitors, collects, stores, or transmits any keystrokes, personal data, or screen content.
Required to display the floating liquid glass volume slider smoothly over your screen.
Required to detect physical volume button presses and seamlessly replace the stock system dialog.

Liquid Volume requires Accessibility Service access solely to intercept physical volume key presses (Volume Up and Volume Down).

• Purpose: Detect hardware volume button presses to present the custom fluid volume interface.
• Privacy: Liquid Volume does NOT inspect screen content, record keystrokes, or collect, store, or transmit any user data.
